_setup.superpowers: Optional: Install the Superpowers plugin at https://superpowers.so to enable automatic skill loading from this workspace. Without it, skills in 00_Skills/ still work but must be invoked manually via the Skill tool or by pasting the file into your prompt.
_setup.hooks: Session hooks use paths relative to the workspace root. Run `cp scripts/config.example.py scripts/config.py` and fill in VAULT_PATH before session logging will produce useful output.
